cold.mode_description: unique synthetic incidents exercising the HTTP mock-provider path
cold.environment: local Docker Desktop; not a production capacity measurement
cold.runtime_note: Throughput is the unadjusted Locust wall-clock value. A wall-clock interval above the configured duration indicates a local host or Docker scheduling pause.

warm.mode_description: fixed 60-fixture set exercising the assessment-cache path after warm-up
warm.environment: local Docker Desktop; not a production capacity measurement
warm.runtime_note: Throughput is the unadjusted Locust wall-clock value. A wall-clock interval above the configured duration indicates a local host or Docker scheduling pause.

interpretation: Cold exercises unique provider-path requests; warm repeats 60 fixtures to measure the cache path. The modes provide separate evidence and are not interchangeable.
